FN-6YT8F13-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 362
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Economic Development
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/16/2026
Senate Bill 362 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of state agencies that
opt to administer any of its programs using the tiered rural classification system to adopt rules
implementing the system as provided by this bill.
